snippet.title: Echoes of Mystralia | Language Update
snippet.description:
Watchers from around the world can now play Echoes of Mystralia's demo in 8 new languages: Italian, German, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, and Latin American Spanish, in addition to English and French.

Try our free demo on Steam 🧙: https://bit.ly/EomSteamDemo

Echoes of Mystralia is an action-heavy spellcrafting ARPG roguelite, where rapid combat meets deep customization. Craft your own spells, unlock new combinations, fight epic bosses, and discover a narrative-rich world that never plays the same twice.

Join us in Mystralia:
Discord : https://discord.gg/Ge4sysstj3 
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/mystralia.games/ 
TikTok : https://www.tiktok.com/@echoesofmystralia
Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/mystraliagames/   
X : https://x.com/mystralia 
Newsletter : http://eepurl.com/iJ72B2
